simple.meaning: מַטָּע (maṭṭâʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “something planted , i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant , figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַטָּע (H4302) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 60:21, with occurrences in Isaiah, Ezekiel, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַטָּע (H4302) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַטָּע (H4302) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַטָּע (maṭṭâʻ) / H4302 is traced through Isaiah 60:21, Isaiah 61:3, Ezekiel 17:7, Ezekiel 31:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: something planted , i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant , figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting
definitions.full: H4302. matta מַטָּע noun masculine place, or act of planting; plantation ; — absolute ׳מ Ezek 34:29 ; construct מַטַּע Isa 61:3 ; suffix מַטָּעוֺ 60:21 (Kt; Qr מַטָּעַי ); מַטָּעָהּ Ezek 17:7 , also 31:4 , but read ᵐ5 מַטָּעֹה Hi Co Berthol Toy; plural construct מַטָּעֵי Micah 1:6 ; — 1 planting-place , כָ֑רֶם מַטָּעֵי Micah 1:6 planting-place for a vineyard , so Ezek 31:4 (read מַטָּעֹה , see above); probably also ׳מ לְשֵׁם < read ᵐ5 ׳מ שָׁלֹם Co Berthol Toy i.e. peaceful (fruitful) planting-place ; compare מ ׳עֲרֻגוֺת 17:7 = beds where it was planted. 2 act of planting מ ׳נֵצֶר Isa 60:21 shoot of his (my) planting (figurative of people). 3 ׳מ ׳י Isa 61:3 plantation of ׳י (id.).
